title: Add webhook retry-with-backoff mechanism
description: Outbound webhook delivery currently attempts a single POST and gives up on failure. Add retry-with-exponential-backoff (bounded attempts, jitter) so transient receiver failures (5xx, timeout) are retried, while permanent failures (4xx other than 429) are not retried.
acceptanceCriteria: A 5xx or timeout response triggers a retry following exponential backoff with jitter, up to a configurable max attempt count.
A 429 response is retried honoring any Retry-After header if present.
A non-429 4xx response is not retried and is recorded as a permanent failure.
After the max attempt count is exhausted, the webhook is recorded as failed with the attempt history preserved.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run retry-behavior tests using fake timers to assert backoff timing, jitter bounds, and the 4xx-vs-5xx retry distinction without real delays.
groundTruth: A retry loop classifies the response status into retryable vs terminal, computes the next delay as base * 2^attempt bounded by a max delay and randomized within a jitter window (or the Retry-After value when present), and records each attempt in an attempt-history array.
